text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A for a gain felt good, but I should base future sales on the investment outlook, not just the pleasure of locking in a profit.","I made no trades as my account fell from 97,278 to 81,564; holding through losses is not automatically the right choice, so I should reassess positions rather than avoid admitting a mistake.","I should judge my overall portfolio and its risk, not treat each stock as a separate account whose losses I feel compelled to recover."]}
